newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Late bargain-hunting pushes Portuguese shares up.
newsitem.headline: Late bargain-hunting pushes Portuguese shares up.

text.p: 1615 GMT - Bargain hunters pushed Portuguese shares to a higher close in thin trade after prices took a battering earlier in the day from the French left's election win.

*Dealers said holidays in London and New York had reduced interest. They said volume would increase on Tuesday but the forthcoming privatisation of the EDP electricity group would continue to divert investor interest away from other shares.
*The PSI20 index ended 29.90 points lower at 6,620.52.
*PSI20 June futures were up 53 points at 6,644.
*Portugal Telecom climbed 30 escudos to 6,690 on volume of 143,183.
*Paper company Inapa lost 60 esc to end at 5,760 with 111,442 shares traded.
*Cement holding company Semapa closed 129 higher at 4,130 on volume of 8,500 after the company said it would increase sales by six percent this year.
